subject: Request for compact value pack and executive summary for renewal / expansion - Elara Health
messages:
From: Brianna Cole <brianna.cole@elarahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Yeo <m.yeo@elarahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need compact value pack for upcoming renewal discussion

Hi Vanessa —

Hope you’re well. Our renewal conversation with finance is scheduled the week after next and the CFO has asked for a tight, numbers-first packet that shows the incremental value Redwood has delivered: adoption growth, token costs, latency improvements impacting customer SLAs, and the projected ROI if we expand seats.

Can you provide a short (1–2 page) executive summary plus a one-sheet with the usage and cost delta we can share internally? If possible, include a simple blurb we can drop into an internal case study and a topline quote for +200 seats (we’ll use it for budget planning).

Attachments: none from our side yet.

Thanks — Brianna
Brianna Cole
Head of Customer Success, Elara Health
[brianna.cole@elarahealth.com]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Brianna Cole <brianna.cole@elarahealth.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need compact value pack for upcoming renewal discussion

Hi Brianna —

We can absolutely do that. I’ll assemble: 1) a one-page executive summary for CFOs highlighting ARR impact and cost per active seat; 2) a one-sheet with usage and latency deltas and 3) a short customer-quote blurb for internal comms.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 6/30: draft one-pager and usage export
- Wed 7/1: review call (15 min) and finalization
- Thu 7/2: delivery of consolidated pack (PDF) + HubSpot deal update

Dylan (CC) will drop the raw usage export and adoption metrics; Monica will draft the exec blurb and suggested quote for +200 seats. If you need different framing for procurement vs finance, let us know.

I’ve included a short template (attached) you can point your CFO to — it’s intentionally concise.

Attachments:
- Template: redwood_exec_value_template.docx (stub)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Brianna Cole <brianna.cole@elarahealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need compact value pack for upcoming renewal discussion

Hi team — sharing the preliminary numbers requested. This is a quick export; Vanessa/Monica I can polish for the one-sheet.

Key highlights (90 day window vs prior 90 days):
- Active seats using Redwood features: +36% (from 420 -> 571 active seats)
- Monthly token consumption (prod): +28% with per-token cost down 12% after batching/quant settings we recommended
- Avg request latency (p95): improved 210ms -> 130ms for the primary embedding flows (42% improvement)
- Error rate: <0.2% over window (meets SLA)
- Estimated annualized value from reduced operator time + faster workflows: ~$410k (conservative)

Attachments:
- elara_usage_export.csv (stub, includes daily active seats and token volumes)
- Dashboard snapshot: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/ELR-usage-snapshot

Notes: I recommend we highlight the p95 latency improvement (that’s resonant with engineering/ops) and the per-seat unit economics for finance. Happy to run a quick calc for the 200-seat incremental quote once Vanessa confirms target term (12 vs 24 months).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Brianna Cole <brianna.cole@elarahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elara Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>, Marcus Yeo <m.yeo@elarahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need compact value pack for upcoming renewal discussion

Perfect — thank you both. A couple of follow-ups:

1) Can the one-pager be phrased as an ROI statement directed at our CFO (high-level cost savings + 3-yr projection)?
2) Procurement needs a topline quote for 200 additional seats for both a 12-month and 24-month term; please include any discount bands for committed spend.
3) We’d like a 2–3 sentence executive quote that our internal comms team can use for the renewal announcement and an optional short case blurb we can publish (subject to legal review).

Procurement has also asked for any signed contract redlines we previously agreed to — I’ll loop them in but a PDF of the latest redlined MCP will help.

Thanks again — can we target your Wed review then?

Best,
Brianna

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Brianna Cole <brianna.cole@elarahealth.com>, procurement@elarahealth.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Elara value pack and quote (pack attached)

Thanks for the guidance. Attached is the consolidated deliverable we discussed:
- Elara_Value_Pack_2026-07-02.pdf (1-page executive summary, 1-page usage/cost sheet, 1-page customer blurb + quote)

Link to HubSpot deal and PDF: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-547
